config.label: Sift API key
config.description: Sift API key. Used in the Events API request body ($api_key) and as the HTTP Basic auth username (empty password) for Score + Decisions APIs.

config.label: Sift Account ID
config.description: Sift Account ID. Required for all Decisions API v3 endpoints (path segment /v3/accounts/{account_id}/...).

config.label: Sift API base URL
config.description: Sift API base URL. Defaults to https://api.sift.com.
